title: Tampa Scavenger Hunt Walking Activity
includes: One scavenger hunt interactive walking tour for your entire group
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Must have smartphone with cellular data service.
IMPORTANT: Registration Instructions will be found on the Voucher & Email after completing purchase
Must be able to walk around 2 miles.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Explore Tampa like never before on this interactive scavenger hunt walking activity. Discover the city’s fascinating history, from its origins at Fort Brooke to its vibrant identity as 'Cigar City'. As you traverse the scenic 2.5-mile route, take in landmarks like the stunning Bayshore Boulevard and Amalie Arena while snapping photos and solving fun puzzles. This self-guided adventure allows you to set your own pace, making it perfect for families, friends, or couples looking to enjoy a unique day out. Dive into trivia about baseball legends and local lore, all through the convenience of an interactive app.
